error_account_unsupported_pkce: Sign-in couldn't start: the account service doesn't accept the sign-in method the app asked for. Update the app and try again.
error_cache_generic: The app's local database failed. Restart the app and try again.
error_config_parse: The settings file couldn't be read or saved. Restart the app, or fix the file by hand if you edited it.
error_download_ffmpeg_missing: This download needs ffmpeg, and it isn't installed.
error_download_tool_failed: The downloader stopped with an error before the file was finished. Try again later.
error_download_tool_spawn_failed: The downloader couldn't be started. If you installed yt-dlp or ffmpeg yourself, check that it runs; otherwise reinstall ani-gui.
error_io_generic: A file on this computer couldn't be read or written. Check free space and permissions, then try again.
error_metadata_source: The account service couldn't complete this request. Try again, or reconnect the account in Settings.
error_network_rate_limited: The service is busy right now. Wait a few seconds and try again.
error_network_unreachable: Couldn't reach the service. Check your connection and try again.
error_network_upstream: The service answered with an error (HTTP {status}). Try again later.
error_play_episode_unavailable: The source lists this show but has no stream for this episode in the chosen audio.
error_play_stream_server_failed: The source lists this show, but its video server didn't serve a playable stream for this episode. Try again later, or try another episode.
error_player_spawn_failed: Couldn't start {binary}. Check the external player in Settings.
error_request_invalid_body: The app sent a request that couldn't be read. Restart the app and try again.
error_request_invalid_kitsu_id: The app asked for an anime by an id that isn't valid. Go back and open it again.
error_request_invalid_search_offset: The app asked for a page of search results that doesn't exist. Search again.
error_scraper_parse_failed: The service sent an answer the app couldn't read. Try again later.
error_scraper_timeout: The service took too long to answer. Try again in a moment.
error_search_no_results: Couldn't find this title on the streaming source.
error_stream_invalid_token: This session is no longer valid: a stream link expired, or an account's sign-in was refused. Start the episode again, or reconnect the account in Settings.
error_syncplay_spawn_failed: Couldn't start Syncplay ({binary}). Check that it's installed and its path in Settings.
